title: Paul McCartney live: Westfalenhalle, Dortmund | 1993
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Westfalenhalle in Dortmund, Germany, on 19 September 1993.

It was the 45th night of the New World Tour, which lasted for 77 dates across 19 countries between February and December 1993, and the second of three non-consecutive nights in Dortmund.

McCartney’s band was Linda McCartney on vocals, keyboards, and percussion; Hamish Stuart on guitar, bass guitar, and vocals; Robbie McIntosh on guitar and vocals; Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens on keyboards and vocals; and Blair Cunningham on drums and percussion.

McCartney had previously performed at the Westfalenhalle during the Paul McCartney World Tour on 16 and 17 October 1989.
